meta.name: Lunatics 2019
meta.description:
This mockumentary series follows the peculiar lives of six eccentric -- and sometimes obscene -- misfits who march to their own beat.

Rated 18 · Ended · First aired 19 Apr 2019 · United States of America · Language: English · 36 min
Studio: Princess Pictures · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Meet a fashion wannabe, a 7-foot-3 college girl, an obnoxious child heir, a pet psychic to the stars, a former porn star and a cocky real estate agent.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Quentin starts his transition to CEO. Jana explains more about her psychic methods. Gavin learns Gayhurst history. Joyce describes her "collection."

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jana plans a pet art show. Keith has big ideas for the new store. Becky struggles to fit in at college. Quentin goes all out for his 30th birthday.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Becky pours her efforts into a YouTube channel. Keith stages a grand opening. Gavin makes a friend and a raunchy video. Joyce has neighbor problems.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gavin and his cohorts engage in "lit activities." Quentin tries to become a street artist. Jana searches for her aardvark. Joyce has financial issues.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Becky pines for Lingers. Jana tries virtual reality. Quentin wants to lay down some EDM vocals. Keith and Marilyn talk about what she saw.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gavin and the Frothers go on a hunger strike. Becky tries to let loose at a party. Patika gets upset about Karen. Joyce is asked to return to porn.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jana is fed up with Kylie's impending wedding. Quentin hones his DJ persona. Joyce gets an eviction notice. Gavin receives visitors at Gayhurst.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Quentin makes his long-awaited DJ debut. Becky fesses up to her fans. Keith launches his fashion line. Jana makes a plea to Kylie in Zimbabwe.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Six months have passed, and there have been big changes in the lives of Becky, Gavin, Jana, Joyce, Keith and Quentin.
